name: io.github.r4-ndm/vaughan
description: Self-custody wallet for autonomous agents. Keys stay in a local Rust vault; the agent gets an allowance (per-asset 24h cap + destination allowlist) instead of a key. Read-only quotes, proposals, swaps, transfers and DCA under policy; every money path is charged against a persisted spend ledger.

environmentVariables.name: VAUGHAN_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Profile to expose. Use 'default' (adviser: agent proposes, human approves) or 'sentient' (agent's own wallet, auto-executes under policy).

environmentVariables.name: VAUGHAN_BIN
environmentVariables.description: Path to an existing vaughan binary. When unset the package downloads the pinned release for this platform and verifies its SHA256.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.runtime_requirement: A running `vaughan serve --password-env <VAR>` (or an unlocked TUI) on the same machine. The MCP process only proposes; it never holds an unlocked vault.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.safety: No approval card is required in sentient mode by design. Losses are bounded by the spend ledger: daily_cap_pct (default 20% per asset per 24h) and allow_transfer_to (default empty = all transfers refused).
